name: @guardbee/mcp-document-scanner
description: Finds PII and credentials inside PDFs, screenshots and scanned documents before they reach an LLM
long_description: Reads documents the way a text DLP cannot: the PDF text layer, and OCR (Turkish and English, via the optional tesseract.js and @napi-rs/canvas packages) for images and scanned pages. Runs the GuardBee detectors on the text — checksum-validated TC Kimlik No, VKN, IBAN and card numbers, passport, SGK, MERSİS, date of birth, address, e-mail, KEP, phone and 22+ credential formats — and reports each finding with its page and how the text was read, showing only the first and last characters. Tools: scan_document (file or folder), scan_base64, list_detectors. The CLI writes text, JSON or SARIF 2.1.0.
